faq.a: Telefonunda, şifreli olarak. Bulut eşitlemeyi açmadıysan hiçbir sağlık kaydın cihazından çıkmaz; partner özelliği yalnızca paylaşmayı seçtiğin yakınlık durumunu gönderir. Ayrıntılar Gizlilik Politikası'nda.

Eski telefonda {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_export}} ile bir yedek al. Yeni telefonda aynı ekrandan {{privacy_import}} ile geri yükle. Ya da {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_cloud_account}} ekranında bulut eşitlemeyi aç; yeni telefonda karşılama ekranındaki "{{onboarding_restore}}" ile aynı hesapla giriş yap.

{{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_delete_account}}. Partnerinle eşleştiysen sunucudaki eşleşme bilgilerin ve paylaştığın durum, hesapla giriş yaptıysan hesabın ve buluttaki kopyan da silinir. Uygulama silinip yeniden kurulduğunda eski kayıtlar geri gelmez. Uygulamaya erişemiyorsan hesabının ve buluttaki kopyanın silinmesini {email} adresinden isteyebilirsin.
Abonelikleri mağaza yönetir. iPhone'da: Ayarlar → adın → Abonelikler → Nilu. Android'de: Google Play → Profil → Ödemeler ve abonelikler → Abonelikler → Nilu. İptal, dönem sonuna kadar geçerli kalır.
Premium ekranında {{premium_restore_purchases}} düğmesine dokun. Aynı Apple Kimliği ya da Google hesabıyla giriş yapmış olman gerekir.
Yalnızca paylaşmayı açık rızanla seçtiğin yakınlık durumu (istek düzeyi ve sevgi ihtiyaçları). Döngü tarihlerin, belirtilerin ve notların paylaşılmaz. Paylaşımı kapatınca sunucudaki durumun silinir.

en.hero_body: A calm tracker for periods, pregnancy and the postnatal weeks. Everything you log stays on your phone, encrypted — no tracking.
en.hero_alt: Nilu home screen: days until your next period and the cycle ring
en.coming_soon: Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play
en.features_lead: From periods to pregnancy and the weeks after birth — simple, clear and in your hands.

showcase.label: CALENDAR
showcase.title: Your next period, *shown as a range*
showcase.body: Mark your period on the calendar. Nilu shows the next one as a likely range rather than a single date — with how it was calculated, plus your estimated fertile window.
showcase.alt: Calendar with marked period days, predictions and the fertile window

showcase.label: DAILY LOG
showcase.title: Log *how you feel*
showcase.body: Flow, pain, mood, symptoms and notes, saved in a few taps — and there whenever you want to look back.
showcase.alt: Daily log: flow, symptoms, pain and mood

showcase.label: INSIGHTS
showcase.title: See your body’s *patterns*
showcase.body: How long do your cycles last, how regular are they, which symptoms keep coming back? Your full cycle history and a summary to show your doctor are free.
showcase.alt: Insights: cycle length trend and symptom analysis

showcase.label: ASK YOUR DATA
showcase.title: Answers from *your own entries*
showcase.body: Ask “How many days until my period?” or “Are my cycles regular?”. Answers are worked out on your phone from the same numbers you see in the app — nothing is sent to an AI model, and nothing is made up.
showcase.alt: Ask your data: questions about your next period and cycle regularity, with answers

showcase.label: PREGNANCY
showcase.title: With you *through pregnancy*
showcase.body: Through pregnancy and the postnatal weeks: your week and day, appointments and reminders, and the warning signs that mean you shouldn’t wait.
showcase.alt: Pregnancy home: week of pregnancy, due date and next appointment

more.title: Home Screen widget
more.body: Your cycle day and next period at a glance; the widget and reminders are prepared on your device.

more.title: Health library
more.body: Sourced articles on periods, nutrition, mental health and relationships.

more.title: With your partner, if you want
more.body: Only the closeness status you choose is shared, with your explicit consent.

more.title: Your backup, your call
more.body: Move to a new phone with a password-protected backup, or turn on cloud sync with your account.

privacy_points: Your entries stay on your phone, encrypted. You sign in with your Apple or Google account; cloud backup turns on only if you want it.
Ads are not personalised; no advertising identifier, no tracking prompt.
Your health data is never used for ads and never sold.
App lock, discreet notifications, a plain home-screen icon and password-protected backups — all free.
You can delete all your data from inside the app.
en.privacy_alt: Privacy & Security: app lock and data encrypted on your device
en.medical: Nilu does not diagnose, does not prescribe treatment and is not a contraceptive method. Predictions are calculated from your past entries and are approximate.
en.health_title: All your health data in one place
en.health_body: Using Nilu with the Apple Health app on iPhone empowers you to better manage your health. Import your period records from the Health app and, if you like, write the days you mark in Nilu to Health too, so you see all your health data, including data from Nilu, in one convenient place.
en.health_privacy: Your period data is kept secure in the Apple Health app because it is encrypted and protected with the passcode on your iPhone. You grant permission and can revoke it at any time in the Health app's privacy settings.
en.trademarks_apple: Apple, the Apple logo and iPhone are trademarks of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. App Store is a service mark of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries.
en.trademarks_google: Google Play and the Google Play logo are trademarks of Google LLC.
en.footer_tracking: This site uses no cookies, analytics or tracking.
en.final_title: A *calm* way to listen to your body
en.final_body: Start without an account; sign in with Apple, Google or email if you want a backup. Unless you turn on sync, your entries never leave your phone.
en.support_intro: Having a problem or have a suggestion? Write to us.

faq.a: On your phone, encrypted. Unless you turn on cloud sync, none of your health entries leave your device; the partner feature only sends the closeness status you choose to share. Details are in the Privacy Policy.

faq.q: I'm changing phones; how do I move my entries?
faq.a: On your old phone, create a backup with {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_export}}. On the new phone, restore it from the same screen with {{privacy_import}}. Or turn on cloud sync in {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_cloud_account}}, then on the new phone tap "{{onboarding_restore}}" on the welcome screen and sign in with the same account.

faq.q: How do I delete my data?
faq.a: {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_delete_account}}. If you paired with a partner, your pairing details and shared status are deleted from the server too, and if you signed in, so are your account and cloud copy. Reinstalling the app does not bring old entries back. If you can't access the app, you can request deletion of your account and cloud copy at {email}.

faq.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.a: The store manages subscriptions. On iPhone: Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Nilu. On Android: Google Play → Profile → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → Nilu. A cancellation stays active until the end of the period.
On the Premium screen, tap {{premium_restore_purchases}}. You need to be signed in with the same Apple ID or Google account.

Only the closeness status you choose to share with your explicit consent (desire level and affection needs). Your cycle dates, symptoms and notes are not shared. Turning sharing off deletes your status from the server.

faq.a: Verschlüsselt auf deinem Handy. Solange du die Cloud-Synchronisierung nicht einschaltest, verlassen keine Gesundheitseinträge dein Gerät; die Partnerfunktion sendet nur den Nähe-Status, den du teilen möchtest. Details in der Datenschutzerklärung.

faq.q: Ich wechsle das Handy — wie nehme ich meine Einträge mit?
faq.a: Erstelle auf dem alten Handy ein Backup über {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_export}}. Stelle es auf dem neuen Handy im selben Bildschirm mit {{privacy_import}} wieder her. Oder schalte unter {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_cloud_account}} die Cloud-Synchronisierung ein und tippe auf dem neuen Handy im Willkommensbildschirm auf „{{onboarding_restore}}“ und melde dich mit demselben Konto an.

{{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_delete_account}}. Wenn du mit einem Partner verbunden bist, werden auch deine Verbindungsdaten und der geteilte Status vom Server gelöscht, und wenn du angemeldet bist, auch dein Konto und deine Cloud-Kopie. Nach einer Neuinstallation kommen alte Einträge nicht zurück. Wenn du die App nicht mehr nutzen kannst, kannst du die Löschung deines Kontos und deiner Cloud-Kopie unter {email} anfordern.

Abos verwaltet der Store. Auf dem iPhone: Einstellungen → dein Name → Abonnements → Nilu. Auf Android: Google Play → Profil → Zahlungen und Abos → Abos → Nilu. Eine Kündigung gilt bis zum Ende des Zeitraums.
Tippe im Premium-Bildschirm auf {{premium_restore_purchases}}. Du musst mit derselben Apple-ID bzw. demselben Google-Konto angemeldet sein.

Nur den Nähe-Status, den du mit deiner ausdrücklichen Einwilligung teilst (Lustlevel und Bedürfnisse nach Zuwendung). Zyklusdaten, Symptome und Notizen werden nicht geteilt. Wenn du das Teilen ausschaltest, wird dein Status vom Server gelöscht.

faq.q: Voy a cambiar de móvil, ¿cómo paso mis registros?
faq.a: En el móvil antiguo, crea una copia con {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_export}}. En el nuevo, restáurala desde la misma pantalla con {{privacy_import}}. O activa la sincronización en {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_cloud_account}} y, en el móvil nuevo, toca «{{onboarding_restore}}» en la pantalla de bienvenida e inicia sesión con la misma cuenta.

{{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_delete_account}}. Si te vinculaste con tu pareja, también se borran del servidor los datos de vinculación y el estado compartido, y si iniciaste sesión, tu cuenta y tu copia en la nube. Al reinstalar la app, los registros antiguos no vuelven. Si no puedes acceder a la app, puedes pedir que se borren tu cuenta y tu copia en la nube escribiendo a {email}.

Las suscripciones las gestiona la tienda. En el iPhone: Ajustes → tu nombre → Suscripciones → Nilu. En Android: Google Play → Perfil → Pagos y suscripciones → Suscripciones → Nilu. La cancelación sigue vigente hasta el final del periodo.
En la pantalla Premium, toca {{premium_restore_purchases}}. Debes haber iniciado sesión con el mismo ID de Apple o la misma cuenta de Google.

Solo el estado de cercanía que decidas compartir con tu consentimiento explícito (nivel de deseo y necesidades de afecto). Las fechas de tu ciclo, tus síntomas y tus notas no se comparten. Al desactivar el uso compartido, tu estado se borra del servidor.

faq.q: Je change de téléphone : comment transférer mes données ?
faq.a: Sur l'ancien téléphone, crée une sauvegarde avec {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_export}}. Sur le nouveau, restaure-la depuis le même écran avec {{privacy_import}}. Ou active la synchronisation dans {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_cloud_account}}, puis sur le nouveau téléphone touche « {{onboarding_restore}} » sur l'écran d'accueil et connecte-toi avec le même compte.

{{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_delete_account}}. Si tu es associée à un partenaire, tes données d'association et l'état partagé sont aussi supprimés du serveur, et si tu es connectée, ton compte et ta copie cloud aussi. Après une réinstallation, les anciennes données ne reviennent pas. Si tu n'as plus accès à l'app, tu peux demander la suppression de ton compte et de ta copie cloud à {email}.

Les abonnements sont gérés par le store. Sur iPhone : Réglages → ton nom → Abonnements → Nilu. Sur Android : Google Play → Profil → Paiements et abonnements → Abonnements → Nilu. La résiliation reste active jusqu'à la fin de la période.
Sur l'écran Premium, touche {{premium_restore_purchases}}. Tu dois être connectée avec le même identifiant Apple ou le même compte Google.

Uniquement l'état de proximité que tu choisis de partager avec ton consentement explicite (niveau de désir et besoins d'affection). Tes dates de cycle, symptômes et notes ne sont pas partagés. Désactiver le partage supprime ton état du serveur.

faq.q: Vou trocar de celular; como levo meus registros?
faq.a: No celular antigo, faça um backup em {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_export}}. No novo, restaure pela mesma tela com {{privacy_import}}. Ou ative a sincronização em {{nav_profile}} → {{profile_cloud_account}} e, no celular novo, toque em “{{onboarding_restore}}” na tela de boas-vindas e entre com a mesma conta.

{{nav_profile}} → {{profile_privacy_security}} → {{privacy_delete_account}}. Se você se conectou com seu parceiro, os dados da conexão e o status compartilhado também são apagados do servidor e, se você entrou numa conta, também sua conta e sua cópia na nuvem. Ao reinstalar o app, os registros antigos não voltam. Se você não conseguir acessar o app, pode pedir a exclusão da sua conta e da sua cópia na nuvem pelo {email}.

As assinaturas são gerenciadas pela loja. No iPhone: Ajustes → seu nome → Assinaturas → Nilu. No Android: Google Play → Perfil → Pagamentos e assinaturas → Assinaturas → Nilu. O cancelamento vale até o fim do período.
Na tela Premium, toque em {{premium_restore_purchases}}. Você precisa estar com o mesmo ID Apple ou a mesma conta Google.

faq.q: O que o modo parceiro compartilha?
faq.a: Só o status de proximidade que você escolher compartilhar com seu consentimento explícito (nível de desejo e necessidades de carinho). As datas do seu ciclo, sintomas e anotações não são compartilhados. Ao desativar o compartilhamento, seu status é apagado do servidor.
